gold.metric: Nominal calendar-year mean of World Bank Pink Sheet monthly gold prices
gold.note: 2026 contains January through September only. Historical publication timestamps are absent, so no point-in-time backtest is claimed.

surfaceSales.metric: Median paid USD per acre of sold state surface parcels, varying parcel mix
surfaceSales.note: These are surface parcel sales, not mineral interests. They are neither a Tok mineral-price index nor a guaranteed floor for an option.

holdingCosts.sourceDescription: DNR fact sheet 'Annual Rent' (July 2021), 11 AAC 86.221(b); new rates from the 2020 mining year, which began 1 Sep 2019
holdingCosts.note: Source schedule is July 2021. This integration has not verified later legal changes, claim age, fee allocation or annual-labour obligations. Federal BLM fees are not assigned to state claims.

limitations: State-claim and state-land snapshots are from 2026; sediment samples were collected in 2016.
Point-in-polygon matches do not establish mineral ownership, recoverable quantities, availability, assignment authority or the sediment source.
Federal BLM status and Native corporation ownership are not checked. Native allotments are a separate checked layer.
Land-status codes and the meaning of NTPSTDT remain unconfirmed.
Nearest-claim distances use an approximate local projection; record boundary uncertainty is unknown.
Source summaries are research evidence, not a current legal opinion or an offer to sell an option.
